rules.rule: Controllers pass params to models only through a permit list; never params.permit! or raw params hashes.
Do not interpolate values into SQL strings in where, order or find_by_sql; use placeholders.
Associations used inside a loop over a collection are loaded with includes or preload.
Do not add update_column, update_all or save(validate: false) in application code.
Migrations use change with reversible operations, or define both up and down.
Do not call html_safe or raw on values that include user input.
Do not add API keys, tokens or passwords as string literals; use credentials or ENV.
